name: @agentick/compiler-react-next
description: React adapter for the Agentick v2 JSX-template compiler. `compileToTree(element, opts)` walks a React tree (calling function components, dispatching host elements through `@agentick/compiler-next`'s intrinsic helpers, honoring `useData` suspends via compile-until-stable) and produces `RenderedTree`. `render(element, opts)` composes that with the formatter pipeline for a string. No react-reconciler dep — static templates don't need React's reactive scaffold; hooks that aren't walker-portable throw naturally because no dispatcher is set up.
author: Ryan Lindgren
